name: Moong Dal Chilla
ingredients: ¾ cup split yellow moong dal, rinsed and soaked 3–4 hours
¼ cup water, plus more as needed
steps: Drain the soaked dal. Blend with ¼ cup water, ginger, turmeric and salt to a smooth, thick pourable batter.
Fold in spinach, onion, chilli, cumin and coriander. Rest 5 minutes; add a spoonful of water only if the batter is too thick to spread.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and brush with a little oil. Pour half the batter and spread into a 15–16 cm circle.
Cook 2–3 minutes until the top looks set and the underside is golden. Flip, brush the edge with a little oil and cook 1–2 minutes more.
Repeat with the remaining batter. Serve hot with coriander chutney and plain soy yogurt.
note: Soaking softens the dal for blending. Keep the batter thick so the chillas turn easily. Nutrition is an estimate for the full two-chilla serving.
